entities.name: ApoB
entities.summary: A blood measurement of apolipoprotein B, a protein carried by atherogenic lipoproteins. It helps characterize particle burden.

entities.name: LDL-C
entities.summary: The amount of cholesterol carried in low-density lipoproteins.

entities.name: HbA1c
entities.summary: Glycated hemoglobin reflects average blood glucose over roughly the preceding three months.

entities.name: CRP / hs-CRP
entities.summary: C-reactive protein is a marker of inflammation. High-sensitivity assays measure lower concentrations.

entities.name: Testosterone
entities.summary: Measures a sex hormone involved in reproductive function and other biological processes.

entities.name: IGF-1
entities.summary: Insulin-like growth factor 1 helps evaluate growth-hormone activity.

entities.name: Vitamin D
entities.summary: Blood testing typically measures 25-hydroxyvitamin D to assess vitamin D status.

entities.name: Creatinine / eGFR
entities.summary: Creatinine is a blood measurement used in equations that estimate kidney filtration.

entities.name: ALT / AST
entities.summary: Enzymes measured in blood as part of an evaluation for tissue or liver injury.

entities.name: PSA
entities.summary: Prostate-specific antigen is a protein measured in blood during prostate evaluation and monitoring.

entities.name: HbA1c for diabetes diagnosis
entities.summary: A diagnostic use of glycated hemoglobin, distinct from ongoing glucose monitoring.

entities.name: Coronary artery calcium scoring
entities.summary: CT imaging quantifies coronary calcification to inform assessment of coronary disease risk.

entities.name: PSA screening
entities.summary: Testing people without symptoms raises a separate question about benefits and harms of a screening program.

entities.name: Mammography screening
entities.summary: Breast imaging used in a screening program to detect cancer before symptoms.

entities.name: FIT colorectal screening
entities.summary: Fecal immunochemical testing detects blood in stool as part of a colorectal screening pathway.

entities.name: Colonoscopy screening
entities.summary: A procedure that examines the colon and can remove polyps within a colorectal screening program.

entities.name: HER2-positive breast cancer × trastuzumab
entities.summary: The HERA trial evaluates treatment following chemotherapy in HER2-positive early breast cancer. Recurrence and overall survival require separate interpretation.

entities.name: EGFR-mutated NSCLC × osimertinib
entities.summary: FLAURA compares first-line osimertinib with earlier EGFR inhibitors in advanced, EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.

entities.name: Non-HDL cholesterol
entities.summary: Non-HDL cholesterol and ApoB are compared as cardiovascular risk markers in a UK Biobank discordance study.

entities.name: Cystatin C
entities.summary: Cystatin C and creatinine are compared for kidney-function estimation and risk classification in a cohort meta-analysis.

entities.name: MSI-H / dMMR colorectal cancer × pembrolizumab
entities.summary: KEYNOTE-177 compares first-line pembrolizumab with chemotherapy in metastatic MSI-H / dMMR colorectal cancer.

entities.name: Lipoprotein(a)
entities.summary: Prospective studies examine Lp(a) concentration in relation to coronary heart disease and stroke.

entities.name: Triglycerides
entities.summary: REDUCE-IT reports cardiovascular outcomes with icosapent ethyl in statin-treated adults selected for elevated triglycerides.

entities.name: ALK-positive lung cancer × alectinib
entities.summary: ALEX and J-ALEX compare alectinib with crizotinib in ALK-positive advanced lung cancer, using different doses and populations.

entities.name: BRCA-mutated breast cancer × olaparib
entities.summary: OlympiAD reports progression-free and overall survival with olaparib versus chemotherapy in germline BRCA-mutated, HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer.

entities.name: Resected EGFR-mutated lung cancer × osimertinib
entities.summary: ADAURA reports disease-free and overall survival after resection of EGFR-mutated stage IB–IIIA lung cancer.
